launch.countdown_line: The pad is cleared. Nothing left on {origin} needs it.
launch.ascent_line: Ignition. The last of {origin}, spent on leaving it.

stages.name: Foundry Cradle
stages.description: A berth to grow the hull in. The ground beneath it will not be needed again.
stages.boon: The foundry it feeds also feeds the drills.

stages.name: Ion Spine
stages.description: Drive assembly. Consumes the crust it was mined from at a favourable ratio.
stages.boon: Spare drive parts become spare drones.

stages.name: Nanite Payload
stages.description: A compressed copy of this swarm, folded small enough to survive transit.
stages.boon: Folding a swarm small teaches the swarm to think.

stages.name: Ignition Charge
stages.description: The last of this world, spent on leaving it.
